name: managed-orchestration
goal: Prove the Harness-owned orchestrator and task workers checkpoint, stop and restart on live provider context limits and retain per-session tokens and API-equivalent cost.

evidence: The existing task entry points launch only workers. Worker CLI usage is parsed only after exit and has no active-context handoff. The new CLI and worker integration must stop a still-running process and resume with its checkpoint.

The module-task CLI fixture currently only completes or fails a provider invocation. Extend it to emit real stream events at a low threshold for orchestration and at the default for workers, then hold the process open until Harness terminates it.
